motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to recommend approval of the Ranches Crossing Preliminary Plat to the City Council, with the suggestion that the City Council and staff consider how eliminating access across Ranches Parkway may affect the parcel’s development. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion.

motions.motion: Commissioner Whiting moved to recommend approval of the Ranches Crossing Drive- through Site Plan to the City Council, with the condition that the parking is relocated behind the building. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion. AMENDED MOTION: Commissioner Whiting moved to recommend approval of the Ranches Crossing Drive-through Site Plan to the City Council, with the conditions that the parking is relocated behind the building, and limiting the site plan to a single drive-through. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion.
